purpose: Maximize S1/S2/S3 evidence before S4 by exercising real ASR/TTS software paths with recorded/injected PCM input and a bounded virtual/file/null output sink. This method must not be interpreted as physical microphone/speaker/heard-output evidence.
why_now: WP715 and WP720 current repaired subjects already have successful owner-VPS controller execution receipts awaiting F2 reconciliation.
A composed packet-level Voice-Slice research claim is already owned, so this packet does not create a duplicate semantic claim.

The previous T7-TTS-001 physical-audibility objective blocked all TTS execution because clay-direct-dev has zero audio devices. A separate headless TARGET_RUNTIME_MODEL_BENCHMARK claim now exists for the model-runtime subset.
The next product-level composed Voice-Slice should therefore use the highest faithful nonphysical audio boundary available on VPS rather than jumping to S4.

S1: inject exact prerecorded German PCM/WAV bytes into the real admitted ASR software entry rather than a text surrogate
run TTS model/runtime and consume generated PCM through an in-memory or file sink
measure model/runtime identity, ASR transcript events, TTS produced chunks, timestamps, resource use, cancellation and recovery semantics
S2: if the product output adapter requires an OS audio server/device API, provision a sandbox-local user-space PipeWire/PulseAudio/null-sink style endpoint when compatible with current product code
exercise the actual playback adapter against that virtual sink and capture delivered frames/timestamps
exercise sandbox-local service/session/user permission behavior where representable without real hardware
S3: use a separate-kernel VM only if the admitted audio path specifically requires kernel/device behavior that S2 cannot faithfully provide
virtual audio devices or kernel modules may be used here without risking owner-host kernel state
S4: native OS audio permissions/device enumeration on the owner workstation

composed_scenario.input: pinned real German speech audio fixture with exact file hash and declared relative timing
composed_scenario.barge_in_method: While output frames are being produced/delivered to the sandbox sink, inject a second pinned user-audio fixture through the same ASR ingress. Measure the causal cancellation boundary and reject any later output frames/commits that cross the declared cancel identity.
composed_scenario.restart_method: Checkpoint after a partial/interrupted output, restart the composed software slice inside the disposable sandbox, reenter the same causal session, then process a subsequent clean turn and verify no interrupted/unheard output or stale tool ownership is promoted.

required_observables: exact F2 source/tree and model artifact hashes
ASR partial/final transcript events and monotonic timing
turn-policy decision identity and source packet refs
TTS chunk/frame sequence and producer timestamps
virtual/file sink accepted frame count/byte count/hash and stop boundary
barge-in event identity and cancellation latency at producer and sink boundaries
durable state rows/events admitted versus rejected
outbound model/ASR/TTS inference API counters = 0 during evidence execution
fail_closed: text surrogate used while claiming ASR runtime
prebaked PCM used while claiming TTS model runtime
virtual sink treated as proof a human heard audio
output frames accepted after causal cancellation boundary without explicit tolerated-buffer policy
interrupted/unheard output becomes durable heard/result authority
checkpoint/restart changes session or packet lineage silently
external inference API call during local evidence phase
credits_possible_on_vps: bounded real local ASR software runtime in the composed slice
bounded real local TTS generation/runtime in the composed slice
bounded output-adapter/virtual-sink delivery evidence where executed
next_exact_action: When Trigger 4 claims the single composed Voice-Slice boundary, select the lowest faithful tier: start S1 with real recorded audio input + real local ASR + real local TTS -> file/null sink; promote to S2 only if the existing output adapter requires an OS audio service; use S3 only for separate-kernel audio-device fidelity. Do not request S4 until the remaining discriminator is genuinely physical.
